title: Atlas on a Roll | Classical Motor Controls and Whole-Body RL | Boston Dynamics
title_zh: Atlas 滚动前行 | 经典电机控制与全身强化学习 | Boston Dynamics
abstract:
Robots in the real world experience challenges and conditions we can’t always anticipate or recreate in the lab, so we have to get creative to push the limits. Adding wheels to Atlas was a testbed to see how a learned whole-body controller can work with real actuators, running at the edge of their performance envelopes. 

Learn more about how we test our systems to ensure reliability: https://bostondynamics.com/blog/atlas-on-a-roll/
Join our team: https://bostondynamics.com/careers/
abstract_zh: 现实世界中的机器人会面临我们无法总是预料或在实验室中重现的挑战和条件，因此我们必须发挥创造力来突破极限。为 Atlas 添加轮子是一个测试平台，用于观察学习到的全身控制器如何与真实执行器协同工作，并在其性能包络的边缘运行。了解更多关于我们如何测试系统以确保可靠性的信息：https://bostondynamics.com/blog/atlas-on-a-roll/ 加入我们的团队：https://bostondynamics.com/careers/
tldr_zh: Boston Dynamics 为 Atlas 加轮子，测试全身强化学习控制器与真实执行器的协同。
